{{Quote|But there's a light cruiser, top of the line, from the Kuat Drive Yards, keeping surveillance on this tub right now. Matter of fact, it's a KDY ship; I identified it when I snuck past it. It's the Kuat Drive Yards main security enforcement vessel, and it's armed and very dangerous.|[[N'dru Suhlak]]|<ref name="Hard Merchandise">''[[Hard Merchandise]]''</ref>}}
The '''KDY security cruiser''' was the main enforcement [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] of the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[KDY corporate-security starfleet/Legends|corporate-security starfleet]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the KDY security cruiser, under the command of Kuat Drive Yards [[Chief of Security/Legends|chief of security]] [[Kodir of Kuhlvult]], pursued the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] vessel [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']] into the [[Oranessan system/Legends|Oranessan system]].
